messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 2.2.2.1

2.2.2.1. General Portable fixing and other impact machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way that: — energy is transmitted to the impacted element by the intermediary component that does not leave the device, — an enabling device prevents impact unless the machinery is positioned correctly with adequate pressure on the base material, — involuntary triggering is prevented; where necessary, an appropriate sequence of actions on the enabling device and the control device must be required to trigger an impact, — accidental triggering is prevented during handling or in case of shock, — loading and unloading operations can be carried out easily and safely. Where necessary, it must be possible to fit the device with splinter guard(s) and the appropriate guard(s) must be provided by the manufacturer of the machinery.

Portable fixing and other impact machinery | mustBeDesignedSoEnergyIsTransmitted | energy is transmitted to the impacted element by an intermediary component that does not leave the device | | energy is transmitted to the impacted element by the intermediary component that does not leave the device
enabling device | mustPreventImpact | impact | unless the machinery is positioned correctly with adequate pressure on the base material | an enabling device prevents impact unless the machinery is positioned correctly with adequate pressure on the base material
involuntary triggering | mustBePrevented | involuntary triggering of the machinery | | involuntary triggering is prevented
sequence of actions on enabling device and control device | mustBeRequired | to trigger an impact | where necessary | an appropriate sequence of actions on the enabling device and the control device must be required to trigger an impact
accidental triggering | mustBePrevented | accidental triggering | during handling or in case of shock | accidental triggering is prevented during handling or in case of shock
loading and unloading operations | mustBeCarriedOutEasilyAndSafely | loading and unloading | | loading and unloading operations can be carried out easily and safely
device | mustBeFittableWith | splinter guard(s) | where necessary | it must be possible to fit the device with splinter guard(s)
manufacturer of the machinery | mustProvide | appropriate guard(s) | where splinter guards are fitted | the appropriate guard(s) must be provided by the manufacturer of the machinery
